doc.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011

chapter: Boston, Berklee and the band family
title: Soulive, Lettuce membership and Royal Family Productions
summary: Overlap of members between Soulive and Lettuce, and the agency/label family.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Right. Right. So you got this, you’ve been in and out of Soulive and now this band, the band Lettuce is part of Soulive?

Yeah. Like Eric Krasno, the guitar player is in both. Neil Evans is the keyboardist in Soulive, and is now a member of Lettuce. The only person that isn’t there is Alan the drummer. So it’s myself, Eric Krasno, Neil Evans and the other members who are rhythm guitar player Adam Smirnoff, and the bass player from California, his name is Eric Coomes.
So who books these bands? You have an agency?
Yeah. It used to be called Valor Records out of New York, but now it’s called the Royal Family Productions.
I did see that on your record.

And that incorporates a lot of our family that I was talking about for the past twenty years. You have my band, you have Soulive, everyone has their kind of like solo projects that they’re involved in. And then we all come together and do Lettuce records.
